name: i-sda
description: Interactive visual designer for IBM i DDS display files (DSPF) — preview, click, drag, and edit fields with changes written straight back into the DDS source.

enumDescriptions: Open the designer full-width in the same tab, replacing the split (default) - less cramped, since you don't need the source visible at the same time.
Open the designer in a split column next to the DDS source - lets you see the source and the visual designer side by side.
Open the designer and automatically pop it out into its own window.
isda.designerOpenColumn.description: Where iSDA opens the Screen/Menu Designer, for "Open Screen/Menu Design Preview" and for newly created display files/menus.

editor/title.when: resourceExtname =~ /\.(dspf|DSPF|dspf38)$/ || resourceLangId == dds.dspf || resourceScheme == member || resourceScheme == streamfile

scripts.test: node src/test/extension.test.js && node src/test/createNewDspf.test.js && node src/test/createNewMenu.test.js && node src/test/designerOpenColumn.test.js && node src/test/menu.test.js && node src/test/menuWebview.test.js && node src/test/dspfWriter.test.js && node src/test/fileKeywordsPicker.test.js && node src/test/recordKeywordsPicker.test.js && node src/test/sflRecordKeywordsPicker.test.js && node src/test/fieldKeywordVisibility.test.js && node src/test/dspfParser.test.js && node src/test/dspfEngine.test.js && node src/test/dspfWebview.test.js && node src/test/compileMenu.test.js
scripts.build:webview-assets: node src/fixtures/generateFixture.js && esbuild src/browserEntry.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=DspfParser --outfile=dist/dspfParser.browser.js && node src/buildWebviewTemplate.js && node src/buildMenuWebviewTemplate.js && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});['mnuCmdEngine.js','dspfEngine.js','dspfWriter.js'].forEach(f=>require('fs').copyFileSync('src/'+f,'dist/'+f))"
